title: Add video keyframe extraction pipeline

context.summary: Add configurable local video keyframe extraction and process extracted frame artifacts through OCR/vision roles where frame image bytes are available.
context.background: The video extractor currently reads an embedded MINDORY_VIDEO_MANIFEST fallback. TASK-79 adds a configurable local-command extractor path while keeping manifest fallback and max keyframe limits.

in: Add config catalog settings for video keyframe provider, command, args and timeout.
Implement a local-command video keyframe provider that writes RAW input to a temporary file and parses JSON keyframe output.
Preserve the embedded manifest fallback when local-command is disabled.
Run extracted frame image bytes through configured OCR/vision providers and persist searchable frame artifacts.
Add integration coverage with a fake local keyframe command.
Update docs and validators for video keyframe extraction support.
out: Bundling ffmpeg or heavy local video tooling.
Object-storage persistence of frame bitmap files.

acceptance_criteria: Video keyframe extraction supports manifest fallback and configurable local-command provider.
Local-command extraction reads RAW bytes without mutating the original object and returns capped frame artifacts.
Frame image bytes can be processed by @mindory/llm OCR and vision captioning when those roles are enabled.
Video keyframe descriptions, OCR text and labels are searchable with frame source refs.
Disabled local-command mode remains non-blocking and existing manifest fixtures still work.

manual_checks: Confirm RAW video objects remain immutable and keyframes are derived state.

risks: Command execution must not use a shell or mutate RAW objects.
Local-command provider should remain opt-in and validated.
Frame model calls must go through @mindory/llm providers.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
